source: Independent ERA5 and NASA POWER full-dataset experiments

protocol.method: The same 4,186 April–June rows per source fit preprocessing, weights, calibration and threshold, and are checked afterwards. May metrics filter the same fitted dataset to 1,426 dates.
protocol.calibration: Platt scaling and F1 threshold on all seasonal training scores and labels.
protocol.target: nagpur-grid-proxy-v1; fixed 1981–2010 climate reference, unchanged across benchmark versions.
protocol.limitation: Training-dataset fit; neither calibration nor classification scores are independent estimates of future prediction. Chronological evidence is a separate earlier experiment.

initialization.biases: All hidden and output biases start at zero.
initialization.generator: numpy.random.RandomState; draw input-to-hidden matrix first, then hidden-to-output matrix.

final_fit.calibration_method: Platt map fitted to the same full-dataset ensemble scores and labels; F1 threshold selected on those same 4,186 rows.
final_fit.evaluation_note: All scores are resubstitution on previously seen rows. May is a reporting filter, not a held-out partition.

metrics.note: Analytic expected counts; PR-AUC is the no-skill prevalence reference; F1 is derived from expected counts.

all_season_metrics.note: Analytic expected counts; PR-AUC is the no-skill prevalence reference; F1 is derived from expected counts.
